china-1923:p0837_1.rationale: District salt inspectorates' outstanding revenue, expenses and transfers to group banks; this is salt fiscal administration.

china-1923:p0838_1.rationale: Three-year summary of salt released, revenue receivable and received, expenses and transfers to group banks; this is salt revenue.
